limits: Original native execution, copied-IR prototypes, actual recovered CIL at explicit host boundaries, syntax/stack checks and whole-source compilation have distinct scopes. The reviewed 24-byte reference-enumerator SRET binding is one pinned native caller/body/metadata family, not general generic layout or ARM64 ABI completion. Raw class initialization retains semantic constructor requests only under exact ABI/dead-result/type-origin proof; one ambiguous origin remains unresolved. Caller fragments preserve original local indices, input/member instructions and stores; harness looping and host List<object> are explicit boundaries. They do not execute all of SetStage, combat, native runtime/.cctor bodies, save logic, or whole-game behavior. Full clean source and all ports remain incomplete; compiler diagnostic counts include cascades.
